name: Sanatorium
source: Visual novel Sanatorium is set in a rehabilitation center, where our protagonist, Max, is a dedicated prosthetist. Through his work, he forms deep connections with his patients and colleagues. One of the central characters you'll meet is Emily, a determined young woman who lost her leg in a motorcycle accident. Their story begins in Max's office, where Emily awaits her first consultation—a moment filled with anticipation and hope.
